title: guenthera repanda subsp. dertosensis
intro: Guenthera repanda subsp. dertosensis, commonly known as Guenthera dertosensis, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. As a plant with medicinal properties, it has been used to treat various health issues, including fever reduction and inflammation, due to its health benefits of acting as an anti-inflammatory and antipyretic. The therapeutic actions of Guenthera repanda subsp. dertosensis involve its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
